items.purpose: Consult current official documentation for every relevant native layer before installation writes.
Resolve native capability placeholders and their unsupported-capability behavior.
Install small recipient-neutral global rules, including harness issue reporting.
Send bounded HTTP requests with safe credentials, retries and redirects.
Challenge consequential proposals with grounded evidence and realistic failure modes.
Implement and verify React user journeys, accessibility and visual behavior.
Record an observed harness problem in MAINFRAME and notify the operator.
Operate the resolved infrastructure environment with verified authority and recovery.
Carry an assigned task through execution and verification without changing the recipient role.
Adapt instruction wording and placement to actual recipients and documented product behavior.
Identify and reuse or safely replace the actual project-owned local server.
Use an available external agent for one bounded result and verify its output.
Inspect and maintain effective project guidance without semantic drift.
Establish a small native project instruction hierarchy while preserving existing knowledge.
Implement and verify Python service behavior with the established stack.
Check material acceptance claims against the actual final evidence.
Preserve a concrete out-of-scope repository observation without deferring the active work.
Verify current external claims, numbers and provenance through authoritative sources.
Use registered credentials without exposing protected values to the agent.
Choose or audit meaningful test boundaries, reliability, coverage and execution cost.
Inspect a bounded repository scope and record plausible problems.
Implement eligible autonomous tickets and queue validated fixes for independent verification.
Verify, consolidate and scope existing observations without implementing them.
Independently verify implemented tickets and record evidence-backed closure or return.
Implement and verify Node.js and Next.js server behavior with the established stack.
Identify changed-code suppressions, deferred implementation, and temporary process comments without re-reporting untouched repository debt.
Stop recursive deletion of the filesystem root, the user's home root, or the active project root while preserving authorized narrower cleanup.
A broken hook produces actionable feedback once instead of silent loss of protection, transcript spam, or an endless completion loop.
Prompt a useful structure check when current edits materially enlarge a file, without treating a fixed line count as proof of poor design.
Permit normal local work while respecting the caller's authority for publication, history changes, and destructive Git operations.
Keep protected credential values out of model context while allowing the authorized consumer to authenticate.
Surface high-confidence security regressions in edited Python and JavaScript/TypeScript code, using the project's established tools when useful.
Prevent a known ambiguous tool option from silently producing the wrong evidence, without policing every shell command.
Prevent a commit from including likely credential values introduced by the staged change, without scanning protected stores or unrelated history.
Assign bounded roles dynamically when delegation is useful and supported.
Expose native workflow invocations without duplicated logic or invented commands.
Use supported model and tool options and make skills available to all suitable recipients.
Preserve the working credential helper and private index; the shipped catalog is only an example.
Reconcile ownership and obsolete delivery, inspect effective semantics, and verify actual installed behavior.
